bio.heading: Who we are
bio.text: 2-LIMITED is Cam and Steph — two friends, two one-man bands, one real rock band reimagined in electro-acoustic format. Multi-instrumentalists at heart, they trade guitar, bass, percussion and vocals to fill a room with just the two of them.

bio.heading: Our sound
bio.text: The energy of rock meets the authenticity of acoustic — a Rock, Folk and Pop blend, subtly dosed by two passionate friends. Expect heterogeneity, laughter, and a few tears along the way.

members.name: Cam
bio: Piano at 6, drums at 10, guitar at 14 — the Black Album, Iron Maiden's Seventh Son of a Seventh Son and Queen I & II sealed the deal. Cam formed his first band, Amethys, in high school at 18, and hasn't stopped since: bass, vocals, and self-produced records along the way.

In 2-LIMITED he holds down the low end, drives the beat on cajon, hi-hat and snare played by foot, and sings — bringing years of experience, his own musical universe, a few original compositions, and admittedly terrible jokes. Influences: Queen, Metallica, Iron Maiden, Angra, Supertramp, Nightwish, and many more.

members.name: Steph
bio: Drawn to the magic of music since childhood — especially anything guitar-driven — and fascinated by players like Slash, John Frusciante and Jimi Hendrix, Steph picked up his first guitar and started writing his own music, self-taught, at 14.

In 2-LIMITED he brings the rock-acoustic atmosphere: guitar, percussion, a second voice, and arrangements that dig out the best in every song — complementary to his friend Camille's own talent. Influences: Muse, Radiohead, Slash, Nirvana, Metallica, Red Hot Chili Peppers, Måneskin, Ben Harper. Off stage, his second passion is surfing — a source of values and inspiration that feeds straight back into the music.
